question: Recordings could remember the pointer and every click. What should that give you first?
context: Screen recording tools keep the pointer and the clicks as something you can edit after recording. Photonz only has them burned into the picture, so none of that is possible, and a recording made today can never gain it later.

options.label: Clicks light up
options.summary: Every click in a recording shows as a soft ring where it happened, on a track of its own, so a viewer can follow what was pressed. Turn it off per recording or drag a ring to a different moment.
pros: The thing viewers of a how-to video miss most
Works on every recording with no setup
Small and easy to judge on sight
cons: Only helps recordings made after this lands
options.mitigation: Older recordings open exactly as they do now; nothing is guessed for them.

options.label: The picture follows the clicks
options.summary: Opening a recording offers to zoom in toward each click and ease back out, the way Screen Studio does. Each zoom is an ordinary punch-in on the timeline you can move, stretch or delete.
pros: The most noticeable thing screen recording tools do that Premiere does not
Builds on the punch-in that already ships
cons: Automatic zooms can feel busy if the guess is wrong
Bigger to build than a ring
options.mitigation: Zooms are ordinary, visible keys on the timeline, so a wrong one is a delete away.

options.label: A clean pointer
options.summary: The pointer is no longer part of the picture: it is drawn on top, where it can be smoothed so it glides instead of jittering, made bigger, or hidden for the whole recording.
pros: Fixes the shaky pointer every raw recording has
Hiding the pointer becomes possible at all
cons: Changes how recordings are captured, so a recording opened in another app has no pointer in it
options.mitigation: Export always draws the pointer back in unless you hid it.

options.label: Not now
options.summary: Recordings keep burning the pointer into the picture and nothing else is kept. The video queue carries on without it.
pros: Nothing new to review while the timeline is being rebuilt
cons: Every recording made until then can never have any of this
options.mitigation: Recording the pointer data can be revisited any time; only the recordings made in between miss out.
